title: Talk about your favorite place for shopping – IELTS MASTER
topic: Talk about a time when you gave advice to someone
supporting_text:
Latest Makkar cue cards with new solutions

1. My city is known for two things – food and clothes.
2. The variety in both the categories is just staggering.
3. And the reasonable prices just add to the attraction for the buyers who comprise not only of local residents but also consumers from other states.
4. I too often bought clothes from a shop near by my home.
5. Earlier I did not have a liking for a particular shop but of late I have developed a predilection for a shopping place.
6. The place is Alpha shopping mall.


7. It opened only two months back and has already become a popular place among local residents to hang out.
8. The biggest advantage of the shopping mall is its central location which makes it easily accessible to all the people of the city.
9. But for me the main attraction is the options that it provides me.
10. I am not a brand conscious person but I don’t mind wearing branded clothes either.
11. I am not willing to pay exorbitant price just to put a brand name on my clothes.
12. For me there should be a balance between the appearance of a clothing and the price I pay for it.
13. And that is why I love this place because it gives me that perfect balance.
14. All the major clothing brands have their outlets in this mall.
15. Every time I visit these outlets I can easily find some offers running which allow me to make good purchases within my purchasing power.
16. I might not get the best of the lot but I always get decent clothes at reasonable prices.
17. I have already gathered a nice collection of clothes, shoes and some accessories, all thanks to the shopping mall.


18. There is one more reason why I like this mall and that is its food court.
19. Every time I go there for shopping, I specially reserve extra half an hour for a visit to the food court.
20. I simply love the place for the options it has which I don’t normally find at local food joints.
21. I can choose from all the popular cuisines including Indian, Continental, Chinese, Mexican, Mughlai, Italian and many more.
22. I find this place really refreshing and whenever I am a bit stressed I visit there with my friends.
